cli.reason: Adding a Project as an Agent working folder no longer fails with "Connect this Project on this computer" when the Project's local connection was written by an older CLI without an owner: the add is the account's explicit reconnect and records it as the owner, keeping the connection's generation and default, so the folder then runs. A legacy connection nobody reconnected still never runs work, and a connection owned by another OpenMeld account is still refused. Wire schemas, commands, and arguments are unchanged, so the mandatory CLI floor stays at 0.3.251.

service.reason: OpenMeld Service claims a legacy ownerless local Project connection for the requesting account when that account adds the Project as a working folder; running a Project folder or selected repository still requires a connection owned by the requesting account. The local control contract is unchanged, so the mandatory Service floor remains 0.3.264.

skills.reason: Guidance clarifies existing command prefixes, addressing, and Computer operations without adding runtime authority.
